sets.title: Validation rule classes with identical conditional error handling that CAN be consolidated
sets.description: Three validation classes that each have the same pattern of checking a field, returning false on empty, and collecting errors in an errors array. These conditional fragments should be consolidated into a shared validation helper.
sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Validation\Consolidated;

class ValidationHelper
{
    public static function validateRequired(mixed $value, string $fieldName, array &$errors): bool
    {
        if (empty($value)) {
            $errors[] = "{$fieldName} is required";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static function validateNotBlank(string $value, string $fieldName, array &$errors): bool
    {
        if (trim($value) === '') {
            $errors[] = "{$fieldName} cannot be blank";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static function validateMinLength(string $value, int $min, string $fieldName, array &$errors): bool
    {
        if (strlen($value) < $min) {
            $errors[] = "{$fieldName} must be at least {$min} characters";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class UserValidator
{
    public function validate(array $data): array
    {
        $errors = [];
        
        if (!ValidationHelper::validateRequired($data['username'] ?? null, 'username', $errors)) {
            // consolidated
        }
        if (!ValidationHelper::validateRequired($data['email'] ?? null, 'email', $errors)) {
            // consolidated
        }
        if (!ValidationHelper::validateNotBlank($data['username'] ?? '', 'username', $errors)) {
            // consolidated
        }
        
        return $errors;
    }
}
